title: Flow Indicator

introduction.definition: A flow indicator gives a simple visual confirmation that liquid is flowing. In the rotor type, a paddle wheel behind a window turns when liquid passes; the faster it spins, the higher the flow. It is not a measuring instrument but an essential check on cooling, seal-flush and lube lines.
applications: Cooling water to bearings and coolers
key_points: Rotor, flapper, ball or variable-area types
introduction.summary: A flow indicator shows at a glance whether liquid is flowing. In the rotor type a paddle wheel behind a window spins when liquid moves, its speed roughly following the flow rate. It is used on cooling-water, seal-flush and lubrication lines.

foundation: Support the valve and adjoining pipe so the body does not carry pipe weight or thermal loads; heavy valves need their own supports.
alignment: Align flanges face-to-face and bore-to-bore before bolting; never pull pipes into place with the bolts.
Respect the flow-direction arrow on the body.
piping: Flush the line before installing the valve so welding debris cannot damage seats.
Provide isolation and drain/vent points for maintenance.
Allow access for the handwheel/actuator and for removal of internals.
commissioning: Check the valve strokes fully and smoothly.
Pressure-test the line (shell test) with the valve partly open; do not use the valve to blind a test above its seat rating.
Record the as-installed position and set points.

video_tutorials.title: Flow Indicator — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Flow Indicator.
A flow indicator gives a simple visual confirmation that liquid is flowing.
In the rotor type, a paddle wheel behind a window turns when liquid passes; the faster it spins, the higher the flow.
It is not a measuring instrument but an essential check on cooling, seal-flush and lube lines.
Typical applications include seal-flush and quench lines; cooling water to bearings and coolers; lubrication returns; chemical dosing lines.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Body with Rotor Chamber, Rotor (paddle wheel) — spins with flow.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Flow Indicator — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Flow Indicator.
Confirm rotor turns.
Clean window and rotor.
Replace rotor/bearing pins.
Watch for rotor jammed: no rotation with flow. Common cause: debris, scale.
Watch for window fouled: cannot see. Common cause: deposits.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
